summary: Operator site + Campspot: Lazy Fish LLC runs Stutsman County's Pelican Point Landing; $25/$30 W/E, $35/$40 FHU (+13% Campspot), holiday +$5 with 3-night minimum; 55 RV sites (39 W/E + 16 FHU, max 58 ft), 20 tent, 7 cabins; all nightly, no seasonal offer anywhere on its pages. WATERFRONT lead: lakefront -> lakeview (closest RV sites ~65-80 m from the water with the swim beach between). Pin acceptable.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (downgrade): lakefront -> lakeview. On the 2024 site map the RV sites nearest the reservoir are 55, 56 and 57 (north side of the main road east of the bar). On Esri imagery the RV pads along that road (around 47.0063,-98.7397) are ~65-80 m from the waterline, with the park's own wide sand swim beach ('Large Beach Area'), a bollard row, a lawn with picnic tables and the playground between; the full-hookup sites (loop 25-54) and sites 1-24 are farther back, partly behind trees. The stored evidence ('open grass/sand apron directly fronting the beach ~40 m') was taken at 47.0062,-98.7388, which on imagery is the park road at the lawn's edge, and it counted the sand beach as apron; the beach is day use, so on-water fails. Open view of the water over the lawn and beach from 55-57 supports lakeview. Sites are sold by the night.

LONG-STAY: none on the operator's pages: lazyfish.camp and Campspot sell only nightly RV/tent/cabin stays; no seasonal, weekly or monthly offer. Note for the reviewer: imagery shows a trailer-court-like block of residential-looking units with sheds/decks south of the campground (around 47.0035-47.0040,-98.7410 and a row along the road to the east, ~47.0033,-98.733); neither the Lazy Fish map nor Campspot includes them, so they are not part of this campground's offer (likely private or leased lots). Google 4.6 (35).

OWNERSHIP: stored local. The campground is Stutsman County's Pelican Point Landing run as a concession by Lazy Fish, LLC (county page: 'Pelican Point Lazy Fish, LLC Online Reservations'). Left as local (county park); reviewer may prefer private for a for-profit concession.
